item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 02/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now affecting the coast of Guangdong will be replaced by a dry easterly airstream gradually in the next couple of days. Temperatures over the coast of southern China will rise. The weather will be generally fine, warm during the day. A band of clouds will cover the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong towards the weekend and early next week. There will be a few showers over the region. Winds are expected to be weak over Guangdong midweek next week. It will be rather warm during the day.
